summary: An inbox of four conversation rows: unread count, pinned, muted, typing, with the selected row highlighted.
use: Chat or support inboxes that list conversations with avatar, last message, time and unread state.
spec: 4 rows in `rows`, each a `<ConversationItem` with `title`, `time` and `preview`
`active={active === row.id}` and `onclick={() => (active = row.id)}` select a row
